name: Saionji Miyabi
source:
Miyabi Saionji is a character that first appears in Megurimusubi-hen in P Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Meguri (pachislot). She also appears in Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei.

[From 07th Expansion Wikia]
